import os

"""Wrong model block: state-1 emission, insert line, MAP/CONS annotations, truncated model."""
from pathlib import Path
import os


def write(path, text):
    tmp = Path(str(path) + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(text)
    os.replace(tmp, path)


p = Path("LuxC.hmm")
lines = p.read_text().split("\n")

for i, l in enumerate(lines):
    t = l.split()
    if t[:1] == ["1"] and len(t) == 26:          # state 1 match line
        assert t[1] == "2.07294" and t[5] == "3.48431" and t[21] == "1" and t[22] == "l", t[:6]
        t[1] = "2.37294"                        # wrong emission score
        t[21] = "2"                              # wrong MAP index (exact integer)
        t[22] = "m"                              # wrong consensus residue
        lines[i] = "    " + "  ".join(t)
        # insert-emission line directly below this state line
        ins = lines[i + 1].split()
        assert len(ins) == 20 and ins[0] == "2.68618", ins[:3]
        ins[5] = "2.90513"
        lines[i + 1] = "          " + "  ".join(ins)
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit("state 1 line not found")

for i, l in enumerate(lines):
    if l.split()[:1] == ["LENG"]:
        assert l.split()[1] == "400"
        lines[i] = "LENG  399"
        break
term = lines.index("//")
assert lines[term - 1].split()[0] == "0.00994"
del lines[term - 3:term - 1]                     # drop final match state
lines.append("")
write(p, "\n".join(lines))
print("mutated model block (emission, insert, annotations, truncated tail)")

import re
import os
